entries.title: Theme admin list showing SaaS.
entries.notes: Capture with only the core Capell stack, Foundation Theme, Layout Builder, and capell-app/theme-saas installed in the isolated demo harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator confirms the SaaS theme is available through the core Themes resource without installing another theme package.

entries.title: Signed admin preview route.
entries.notes: Capture a signed preview URL generated with CreateThemePreviewUrlAction for the seeded SaaS theme, site, and page.
entries.useCase: An administrator opens a signed preview URL to inspect a page with the SaaS theme applied before publishing the theme choice.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with SaaS theme.
entries.notes: Capture the seeded Launchdeck page after installing capell-app/theme-saas and building the Foundation Theme/frontend assets.
entries.useCase: A visitor sees a seeded product page rendered through the SaaS navigation, hero, features, proof, content listing, CTA, and footer sections.

entries.title: SaaS homepage.
entries.notes: Capture the product homepage with activation hero, feature proof, dashboard panels, workflow cards, and trial CTA.
entries.useCase: A SaaS team checks that the theme sells product workflow and activation rather than broad startup marketing.

entries.title: Feature page.
entries.notes: Capture feature narrative, workflow steps, comparison blocks, proof, and demo CTA.
entries.useCase: A product team reviews whether feature pages explain jobs-to-be-done instead of becoming a services grid.

entries.title: Pricing page.
entries.notes: Capture pricing plan cards, feature comparison, FAQ, trial risk reducers, and CTA. Requires capell-app/content-sections; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A SaaS buyer can compare plans and move toward a trial without the page feeling like Commerce merchandising.

entries.title: Documentation page.
entries.notes: Capture docs navigation, article content, related links, and product onboarding CTA. Requires capell-app/document-lifecycle; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A product team checks that docs support activation without overlapping Knowledge's editorial archive.

entries.title: Product blog article.
entries.notes: Capture a product article with hero, author, related resources, feature links, and demo CTA. Requires capell-app/blog; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A SaaS team can publish launches and education while keeping product activation visible.

entries.title: Demo request page.
entries.notes: Capture demo request qualification, routing, success state, and product proof. Requires capell-app/form-builder; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A sales team checks that demo conversion stays tied to product workflow rather than broad contact.

entries.title: Webinar landing page.
entries.notes: Capture webinar agenda, speakers, product takeaways, and registration CTA. Requires capell-app/events; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A SaaS team can run product education events without drifting into Agency campaign pages.

entries.title: Knowledge search page.
entries.notes: Capture product knowledge search with docs/blog results, snippets, and onboarding recovery. Requires capell-app/search; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A user can find product help without the page becoming a general Knowledge theme search experience.

entries.title: Launch campaign page.
entries.notes: Capture product launch campaign with variant hero, audience segments, activation proof, and campaign analytics. Requires capell-app/campaign-studio; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A SaaS team can announce launches while keeping the page centred on product activation, not Agency creative delivery.
